dataset_name: Bangladeshi Folklore Story Generation & Evaluation Dataset
purpose: Evaluate AI-generated cultural folklore stories across 12 Bangladeshi cultures

evaluated_stories.csv.role: Main evaluation file with human ratings

columns.culture: Target culture (12 categories: Bengali, Chakma, Garo, Hajong, Khasi, Manipuri, Marma, Mro, Oraon, Rakhine, Santal, Tripura)
columns.model: LLM that generated the story (5 models)
columns.story: Generated folklore story in Bengali (500-700 words)

parquet/*.parquet.role: Embedding files (5 files, one per embedding model)

key_columns.model: LLM that generated the story (LINK KEY)
key_columns.story: Same story text as in CSV
key_columns.scenario_embedding: Vector embedding of the story prompt/scenario
key_columns.story_embedding: Vector embedding of the generated story

IMPORTANT_linking_key: (model, culture) links evaluated_stories.csv to all parquet files - same 599 stories appear in each file with different embeddings
